units: Gen. R. s. 63, beg. (ref. to Prov. XVII, 6) האבות ע׳ לבנים והבנים ע׳ וכ׳ the fathers are a protection to their children (who are saved for their parents’ sake), and the children are a protection to their fathers; v. עָטַר Hithpa.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:14">Ex. R. s. 5</cite> <he>לא היה יודע לשלח לי ע׳</he> did (your God) not have sense enough to send me a crown? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:15:2">Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ע׳ של זית</he> a wreath of olive leaves; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 5:16">Lam. R. to V, 16</cite> <he>עֲטֶרֶת זית</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:3">Tosef. Sot. XV, 3</cite> <he>בטלה עטרת חכמים שעטרת חכמים עושרם</he> the crown (or protection) of the scholars ceased, for the crown of the scholars is their wealth (independence, <cite ref="Proverbs 14:24">Prov. XIV, 24</cite>); <cite ref="Sotah 49b:17">Sot. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>בטלו עַטְרוֹת וכ׳</he>.
Y. Dem. II, 22ᶜ bot., v. עָטַר Hithpa.—

<cite ref="Yoma 69b:14">Yoma 69ᵇ</cite> <he>החזירו ע׳ ליושנה</he> they restored the crown (the praise of the Lord) to its original condition (by re-introducing the phrase <he>האל הגדול הגבור והנורא</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 7:3:9">Y. Ber. VII, 11ᶜ</cite> <he>הַגְּדוּלָּה</he>).
<cite ref="Nedarim 62a:9">Ned. 62ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:5">Ab. IV, 5</cite> <he>אל תעשם ע׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00223"><he>גָּדַל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Megillah 15b:3">Meg. 15ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 111b:3">Snh. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>עתיד הקב״ה להיות ע׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord, in the time to come, shall be a crown on the head of every righteous man (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 28:5">Is. XXVIII, 5</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="P00481"><he>עֲטָרוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 4:2">Ab. Zar. IV, 2</cite> <he>ע׳ של שבלים</he> wreaths of ears (used for idolatrous purposes); Y. ib. IV, 43ᵈ <he>עַטְרוֹת שיבולים</he>. Ib. <he>ע׳ של וורד</he> rose garlands.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:14">Sot. IX, 14</cite> <he>גזרו על ע׳ חתנים</he> they forbade bridegrooms’ garlands; <he>ע׳ כלות</he> brides’ crowns. Ib. 49ᵇ <he>איזהו ע׳ כלות עיר וכ׳</he> what brides’ crowns were forbidden? A golden representation of the city (of Jerusalem); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 87b:6">Sabb. 87ᵇ</cite> <he>אותו יום נטל עשר ע׳</he> that day carried off ten distinctions.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:3">Kel. V, 3</cite> <he>עטרת כירה</he>, v. <cite ref="I00430"><he>טִירָה</he></cite>.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: moulding, sill, cornice.—Pl. as ab. Ohol. XIV, 1.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: the ring around the teat of a woman, as a symptom of puberty.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 47a">Nidd. 47ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 52b:17">52ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שתקיף הע׳</he> until a ring is formed around &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 6:4">Tosef. ib. VI, 4</cite> <he>משתקיף הע׳</he> (not <he>משיקיף</he>); <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 6:5">ib. 5</cite>; a. e.
